1. The State of Bihar  2. Nitu Kumari wife of Aadesh Prasad Village- Sherwa Masjid Ps- Matiyariya  Dist- West Champaran  ... ... Opposite Party/s

======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Brij Kishor Mishra, Advocate  For the State : Mr. Yogendra Kumar, APP  For the Informant : Mr. Bimlesh Kumar Pandey, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RUDRA PRAKASH  MISHRA  ORAL ORDER 2 01-10-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Matiyariya Police Station Case No. 13 of 2024, instituted for the offences under Sections 494, 498A & 379 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The present case arises out of the dispute which is in the nature of matrimonial dispute between the parties, where there is allegation of mistreatment and assault against the petitioner.
Petitioner is husband of the O.P. No.2.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is willing to reconcile the issue with his wife.

Learned Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.66396 of 2024(2) dt.01-10-2024 counsel next submits that petitioner will make all genuine efforts to reconcile the issue so that the reconciliation culminates in restoration of matrimonial harmony between the petitioner and the O.P. No.2.
5.
Learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 does not object to such proposal as long as amicable settlement is reached between the parties.

6. In view of such submissions, since terms of amicable settlement are to be worked out to facilitate the same, the Court directs that till further orders, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection Aadesh Prasad vs The State Of Bihar on 1 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86244657/
1 with Matiyariya Police Station Case No. 13 of 2024, pending in the Court of J.M. 1 st Class, Bettiah,
West Champaran.
